response.sql: WITH per_tx AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_cnt FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS overall_avg FROM per_tx), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_cnt, o.overall_avg FROM per_tx p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_cnt > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_cnt AS avg_anlycount, k.avg_cnt - k.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall_avg, k.avg_cnt - ka.kept_avg AS diff_above_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_avg ka ORDER BY diff_above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-transaction averages (each transaction counts once), not the mean of all rows. Transactions whose anlycount is all NULL have a NULL average and are excluded by the comparison.
The difference from the kept-group average can be negative for kept transactions below that group's mean; no filtering is applied on it, as requested.
